problem_text:
A logistics firm must coordinate a fleet of autonomous drones to inspect nine critical communication towers across a region.  

The flight distances between towers, measured in kilometers, are as follows:  
* Tower 1 to Tower 2: 60.2 km  
* Tower 1 to Tower 3: 113.7 km  
* Tower 1 to Tower 4: 108.7 km  
* Tower 1 to Tower 5: 84.6 km  
* Tower 1 to Tower 6: 54.9 km  
* Tower 1 to Tower 7: 40.5 km  
* Tower 1 to Tower 8: 91.3 km  
* Tower 1 to Tower 9: 32.1 km  
* Tower 2 to Tower 3: 173.9 km  
* Tower 2 to Tower 4: 150.6 km  
* Tower 2 to Tower 5: 109.4 km  
* Tower 2 to Tower 6: 80.8 km  
* Tower 2 to Tower 7: 85.6 km  
* Tower 2 to Tower 8: 151.2 km  
* Tower 2 to Tower 9: 87.9 km  
* Tower 3 to Tower 4: 109.1 km  
* Tower 3 to Tower 5: 136.3 km  
* Tower 3 to Tower 6: 125.3 km  
* Tower 3 to Tower 7: 104.9 km  
* Tower 3 to Tower 8: 28.2 km  
* Tower 3 to Tower 9: 91.3 km  
* Tower 4 to Tower 5: 50.6 km  
* Tower 4 to Tower 6: 157.9 km  
* Tower 4 to Tower 7: 68.9 km  
* Tower 4 to Tower 8: 84.5 km  
* Tower 4 to Tower 9: 79.1 km  
* Tower 5 to Tower 6: 139.4 km  
* Tower 5 to Tower 7: 47.9 km  
* Tower 5 to Tower 8: 108.2 km  
* Tower 5 to Tower 9: 66.4 km  
* Tower 6 to Tower 7: 93.4 km  
* Tower 6 to Tower 8: 113.3 km  
* Tower 6 to Tower 9: 79.0 km  
* Tower 7 to Tower 8: 77.5 km  
* Tower 7 to Tower 9: 19.1 km  
* Tower 8 to Tower 9: 65.4 km  

The objective is to determine the most efficient inspection circuit, where each tower is visited precisely once before the drone returns to its origin, thereby minimizing the total flight distance.
